acf.s100_p: Owning a villa at Coral Vista can open the way to permanent residence in Cyprus for you and your family, once you meet the program conditions.
acf.s101_h2:
Your route to
permanent residence in Cyprus
acf.s103_p: A qualifying property starts at €300,000 plus VAT and must be bought new from the developer.
acf.s105_p: The application can include you, your spouse, and your dependent children. Besides owning the property, you need to show a secured annual income.
acf.s107_p: You need to visit Cyprus once every 2 years to keep the status.
acf.s108_p: Cyprus permanent residence is not Cypriot citizenship, and it does not give the right to live or work across the whole EU.
acf.s110_p: What Cyprus permanent residence gives you
acf.s114_li: You and your family can live, study, and do business in Cyprus.
acf.s115_li: Access to a European standard of living, a Mediterranean climate, and an international community.
acf.s119_li: An education system shaped by the British model.
acf.s120_li: A transparent business environment; corporate tax of 12.5% (as of August 18, 2026).
acf.s121_li: Personal tax depends on your tax residence status, your sources of income, and the rules in force.
acf.s124_h3: Points to note about permanent residence
acf.s125_li: Your right to work and do business, and the tax treatment that applies, must be assessed case by case.
acf.s126_li: Cyprus permanent residence is not Cypriot citizenship.
acf.s127_li: The right to live and work in other EU countries arises only if you hold EU citizenship or a valid residence permit or work permit in that country.
acf.s130_p: The physical permanent residence card is renewed every 5 years, provided you still own the property.
acf.s131_h4: Meet the residence and language conditions
acf.s132_p: At least 8 years of physical residence within an 11-year period, Greek language at CEFR level B1, and a pass in the cultural integration test.
acf.s134_p: Dual citizenship is allowed. A Cypriot passport gives visa-free travel to more than 170 destinations.
